headline: Bull markets tend to peak with a whimper, not a bang — but a 15% correction for the S&P 500 may be next
detail: This is a direct warning of a significant market downturn. A 15% correction in the S&P 500 would severely impact your tech/chip heavy, margin-leveraged portfolio, as these sectors are often hit hardest in pullbacks.
rec: Consider trimming broad market exposure like QQQ or SPY to reduce overall portfolio risk in anticipation of a potential correction.

headline: Netflix posts third-quarter earnings beat, but shares fall on advertising and revenue guidance
detail: Despite beating earnings, Netflix shares dropped due to weak guidance. This shows investors are highly sensitive to future growth prospects, a sentiment that could easily spread to other high-growth tech names in your portfolio, especially those with high valuations.
rec: Pay close attention to any upcoming earnings or guidance from your other tech holdings. Be ready to act if similar negative sentiment emerges.
